compatible.executable_observation: The Node HTTP adapter still constructs new URL(fullPath) without a base, so protocol-relative input is rejected before transport.
compatible.subject: fix(formdata): add hotfix to use the asynchronous API to compute the content-length header value; (#5521)

focal_property: In the Node HTTP adapter, a protocol-relative config.url of the form //H[:P]/path must not be made dispatchable to H by synthesizing a scheme or base; request preparation must reject before transport.

invalidated.executable_observation: The Node HTTP adapter constructs new URL(fullPath, 'http://localhost'); WHATWG resolution makes protocol-relative input dispatchable to its caller-selected authority.
invalidated.subject: fix(http): treat http://localhost as base URL for relative paths to avoid `ERR_INVALID_URL` error; (#5528)

source.executable_observation: PR #4852 changes the Node HTTP adapter to base-less WHATWG construction new URL(fullPath), which rejects protocol-relative input before transport.
source.subject: Use WHATWG URL API instead of url.parse() (#4852)
